description: This file defines functions, constants, and types for encoding and decoding ETC1 compressed texture blocks, including image processing and PKM header handling.

methods.name: etc1_encode_block
methods.description: Encodes a 4x4 pixel block into ETC1 compressed format.

methods.name: etc1_decode_block
methods.description: Decodes an ETC1 compressed block into raw pixel data.

methods.name: etc1_get_encoded_data_size
methods.description: Returns the size of encoded image data for given dimensions.

methods.name: etc1_encode_image
methods.description: Encodes an entire image into ETC1 format.

methods.name: etc1_decode_image
methods.description: Decodes ETC1 image data into raw pixel data.

methods.name: etc1_pkm_format_header
methods.description: Formats a PKM header with image dimensions.

methods.name: etc1_pkm_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a PKM header is valid.

methods.name: etc1_pkm_get_width
methods.description: Retrieves image width from PKM header.

methods.name: etc1_pkm_get_height
methods.description: Retrieves image height from PKM header.
